user_query: I work for a travel agency and I'm looking for unique destinations to offer to our clients. Can you suggest some cities with interesting landmarks or attractions, provide me with their population and coordinates, and recommend some webcams in those cities so that our clients can have a virtual tour before booking?

TaskList.description: Research and suggest unique cities with interesting landmarks or attractions.
Gather the population and coordinates of the suggested cities.
Find and recommend webcams in the suggested cities for virtual tours.
